name: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
notes: TWO-PART MODEL. (1) Vision: 27-layer ViT, hidden 1152, 16 heads, patch_size 16, spatial_merge 2, out_hidden_size 4096, gelu_pytorch_tanh. Note the patch size moved 14 -> 16 vs the Qwen2.5-VL line, so the merge footprint is 32x32 px not 28x28 -- 30% fewer vision tokens for the same image area. DeepStack: deepstack_visual_indexes [8,16,24] injects intermediate ViT features into the LLM at three depths rather than only at the projector, preserving multi-scale detail at low token cost. (2) LLM: 36 layers, hidden 4096, 32 heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, intermediate 12288, rope_theta 5e6, vocab 151,936. ARCHITECTURE = dense. CONTEXT_SCALING = mrope, and this generation changed the layout: rope_scaling is {mrope_interleaved: true, mrope_section: [24,20,20], rope_type: default} in a nested text_config (model_type qwen3_vl_text). rope_type 'default' with a large rope_theta means NO frequency rescaling is applied -- the 262,144 context is native, and mrope only splits the rotary layout. VISION TOKENS: tokens = (H/32)*(W/32). A 896x896 image = 28*28 = 784 tokens; a 1280x720 image = 40*22 = 880 tokens. DOMINANCE: VISION DOMINATES at typical image sizes -- ~800 vision tokens vs a ~200-token text prompt. KV CACHE: 36 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 147,456 B/token (144 KiB), 2.6x Qwen2.5-VL-7B despite similar param count. At 262,144 ctx that is 36.0 GiB per sequence at bf16, so the 262k figure is not a serving target, it is a capability ceiling. params_b 8.767 = HF API safetensors total (8,767,123,696); the name says 8B.
